description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmAdapter, specifically testing decryption functions and capabilities transformation using Google Test framework. It mocks the OpenCDMSession and verifies behavior of session decryption and buffer handling.

classes.name: OpenCdmAdapterTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for OpenCdmAdapter unit tests, setting up mock session and buffers.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that decryption fails when the session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldDecrypt
methods.description: Tests successful decryption when the mock session's addProtectionMeta method is called.

methods.name: ShouldTransformCaps
methods.description: Tests the transformation of caps, expecting success.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that buffer decryption fails when session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenOperationFails
methods.description: Tests decryption failure when addProtectionMeta returns false.

methods.name: ShouldDecryptBuffer
methods.description: Tests successful buffer decryption when addProtectionMeta returns true.
